color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
Findings from the Evidence agent
domain · severity · contradiction · the retrieved passage that supports them
each labelled source = rule (arithmetic) or source = model (judgement)
a finding turning on a date also carries date_source: extracted, declared or computed

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
Seven weighted domains · Tier 1 · totalling 100
data protection and encryption 20 · access control and identity 15
incident response and breach history 15 · compliance posture and certifications 15
subprocessor and fourth-party chain 15 · business continuity, RTO and RPO 10
AI-specific handling — training-data use, model provider chain, output controls 10
Scored over the domains the plan asked about, renormalised to 100 —
not over the tier profile. A freight vendor is not given ten free points
in a domain nobody put a question to

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deterministic arithmetic in Python
every domain starts at its maximum; penalties subtract by severity —
low 2 · medium 5 · high 10
No contradiction multiplier. The anchors price a contradicted claim
the moment the severity is assigned, so no fact is priced twice

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
−25 trust points and forced escalation
the band ignores the arithmetic, and the flag
is written to the vendor record for good

span.p:
One Gemini 3.7 Flash call — the CISO memo
the recommendation, the three things that drove it,
the mitigations required for conditional approval,
and what to re-check in ninety days

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
G1 · human risk acceptance
approve, conditional or reject, with conditions
and a named identity written to the ledger

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Shown, not asserted — the computation goes into
the binder, so anyone who asks why 64? gets the arithmetic

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Why an agent here cannot game its own metric
the model judges severity, the code computes the score —
self-improvement never touches the number.
There is no model call anywhere in this pipeline except the memo.

span.p:
Output screening
drawbridge-output template —
the memo is checked before Elena reads it
